findings.finding: ark-relations 0.4.0 src/r1cs/constraint_system.rs lines 589-624 (the copy cargo extracted into the run's scratch cargo-home) returns format!("{}", i), the 0-based index of the first unsatisfied constraint, when the std feature is off. With std on and no ConstraintLayer it prints a warning to stderr and returns the same decimal index. std requires tracing-subscriber, which is absent from the E2 dependency tree, and E5-r3.stderr carries no ConstraintLayer warning. is_satisfied() is which_is_unsatisfied().is_none(). Candidate circuit.rs documents entry wires synthesized first, and gadgets::alloc_bool emits b*b=b as its single constraint.
findings.effect: The decimal-index format is now source-read and observed. Index 0 identifies input-0 booleanity only through synthesis order; it is not a refusal code and changes with any reordering.
findings.disposition: IR-04 UNVERIFIED-LIB becomes VERIFIED for ark-relations 0.4.0 at the bytes compiled here (extraction equality to the checksummed .crate is a cargo/root trust boundary). Keep the synthesis-order qualification.

findings.finding: Frozen HW-24 text: base H3-P4, 'in poly_b, treat v as UInt with value 2 (non-Bool) to satisfy Eq(v,v)', required unsatisfiable. Its refs execute both halves of the only two ways a witness could carry v = 2: M-10 (public v = 2, honest wire) is refused by the binding equality; M-10/wire (wire and public v = 2) is refused at booleanity constraint 0. By source (binding equates the public slot with the entry wire; alloc_bool constrains that wire) no assignment with public v = 2 satisfies the relation. Unlike HW-23, HW-24 names one entry wire and no computed internal Bool wire.
findings.effect: RELATION-EXECUTED is accurate for HW-24's frozen scope.
findings.disposition: My vote: CONFIRM HW-24 as RELATION-EXECUTED, scoped to the H3 poly_b entry Bool input v with value 2. Root tallies whether this joins the existing single position.

The path is outside <task>, <root>, the five input directories, ~/.cargo and the toolchain. Root attributes it to a separately authorized disjoint Sol source writer.
